_comment: Reading-list entries that live outside this repo (interactive guides, external posts). Paper explainers and blogs are picked up automatically from content/papers/*.md and content/blogs/*.md. After editing, run: python3 scripts/build_reading.py

items.title: LLMs, Token by Token
items.summary: How large language models work, from tokenization and attention to KV caches, PagedAttention, speculative decoding, reasoning models and agents, with animations for every concept.

items.title: Inside the GPU
items.summary: How GPUs work and why AI runs on them: warps, occupancy, the memory hierarchy, coalescing, the roofline model, tiled matrix multiply, Tensor Cores and multi-GPU communication.

items.title: Noise to Image
items.summary: How diffusion models generate images and video, from the forward process and score functions to classifier-free guidance, latent diffusion, DiT and flow matching, built around a real 2-D diffusion model.

items.title: Tokens per Second
items.summary: A hands-on LLM inference guide for people who have never used a GPU: latency and memory math, GPU utilization, batching, KV caches, quantization, speculative decoding, multi-GPU serving, cost and troubleshooting.

items.title: Because You Watched
items.summary: Recommender systems from A to Z: collaborative filtering, two-tower retrieval, deep ranking, bandits, generative recommenders with semantic IDs, and case studies of Netflix, YouTube, Spotify, LinkedIn and more.

items.title: Brain-Rewiring Reads
items.summary: 45 non-technical topics for a curious mind on one page, from attention and habits to deep time, animal minds and Stoicism, with rabbit holes, tiny actions and 21 live demos.
